about_the_game:
Official Demo

Try before you buy: the demo throws you into the thrill of firefighting with two heart-pounding missions – each packed with excitement and challenge. Don’t worry: you’ll get a hands-on introduction first! Explore the detailed fire station and put your skills to the test in the expansive training area. Join the ranks of Oakridge City Fire Department today – your firefighting career starts now! Attention: No Savegame and progression will be carried over.
